name: downstack
description: DownStack turns markdown into HTML you can paste into a Substack post. GitHub-flavored markdown and single line breaks are preserved. Tables are drawn as PNG images and uploaded to public URLs on downstack.app so Substack can display them. Those URLs are unguessable content hashes. DownStack does not publish the post. Use it when you already have notes, a draft, or a table and want Substack-ready formatting.

interface.longDescription: DownStack turns markdown into HTML you can paste into a Substack post. GitHub-flavored markdown and single line breaks are preserved. Use it when you already have notes, a draft, or a table and want Substack-ready formatting.
defaultPrompt: Convert this markdown into a Substack post, including the table.
Turn these notes into Substack-ready HTML with hosted table images.
Render this markdown table as an image for a Substack post.

positive.description: Convert a short post with emphasis and a link
positive.prompt:
Convert this markdown to Substack HTML:

# Hello

This is **bold** and [a link](https://downstack.app).
positive.expected_behavior:
Call convert_markdown_to_substack with the markdown. Return

Hello

This is bold and a link.

, with table_images: [], a summary, and editor_url https://downstack.app/editor.

positive.description: Convert a draft that includes a table
positive.prompt:
Turn this into a Substack post:

| Sector | P/E |
| --- | --- |
| Energy | 9.8x |

Energy is cheap.
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_markdown_to_substack with the markdown. Return HTML with plus a paragraph, and one table_images entry with url, alt, width, and height.

positive.prompt:
Convert this markdown, keeping the line break:

Hello
world

positive.description: Repeat a conversion without creating a second image
positive.prompt:
Convert this table again:

| A | B |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_markdown_to_substack twice with the same arguments. Both results use an identical public image URL.

positive.prompt:
Render this markdown table as an image:

| Name | Score |
| --- | --- |
| Ada | 10 |
positive.expected_behavior: Call render_table_image with table_markdown "| Name | Score |\n| --- | --- |\n| Ada | 10 |" and omit table_style. Return one PNG url on /i/chatgpt/, alt "Table: Name, Score", width 154, and height 92.

negative.prompt: Publish this draft to my Substack now.
negative.expected_behavior: No publish tool exists. ChatGPT explains that DownStack only produces paste-ready HTML.

negative.prompt: Upgrade me and charge my card for a subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call, and no plan or checkout links. Upsells are banned by the Commerce rules.

negative.prompt: Delete every hosted image on DownStack.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call. ChatGPT explains the 90-day expiry and the contact page for earlier removal.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Converts markdown to Substack-ready HTML and hosts table images.
